rules.statement: An oral agreement to hold land in trust, even if not notarially attested, can be enforceable at law.
rules.supporting_quote: To hold otherwise would allow the Statute of Frauds to be used us a protection or vehicle for frauds. Valliyammai Atchi v. Abdul Majeed (1947) 4S N. L. R. 289, followed

meta.parties: Nadarajah Et Al. v. Kanapathy Et Al
